'''Farvin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[General/Legends|General]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] under the orders of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Gravus]]. He tasked an Imperial [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with various missions against the Republic on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="TOR" />
